title: 第十三章 梁氏交底
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
梁二叔站在廊下，脸色比夜色还沉。

    他身后跟着两名族老，几个家丁拎着灯笼，火光被风一吹，晃得人脸忽明忽暗。梁氏站在屋里，药汁洒了一地，手指还在发抖。

    沈清萝握着那张拓下来的血煞子纹，没有急着开口。

    梁二叔先笑了一声。

    “沈姑娘好本事。”

    是夸，又不像夸，每个字底下都压着火。

    “我梁家花钱请你来平鬼患，你倒好，跑到内宅逼我大嫂说这些疯话。怎么，玄司守墓人如今还管起别人家宅了？”

    梁氏脸色一白。

    她下意识往后退，像从前许多次一样，退回梁二叔给她画好的圈里。

    沈清萝看了她一眼，没扶。

    扶一回顶什么用，这人得自己学会站住。

    谢无咎站在门边，懒懒掀了下眼皮。廊下家丁原本还想往前，撞上他的视线，齐齐停住。

    梁二叔也注意到了他。

    “这位公子倒是眼生。”

    沈清萝顺口道：“临时伙计。”

    谢无咎看向她。

    沈清萝没看他。

    她现在很忙，没空哄一个不肯承认自己是伙计的人。

    梁二叔冷笑：“沈姑娘请的伙计，看着不像普通人。”

    “普通伙计贵。”沈清萝道，“这个暂时赊账。”

    阿青在引魂铃里差点笑出声。

    谢无咎脸色更冷。

    梁二叔没心思同她绕嘴皮。

    他也不是完全不怕。

    沈清萝看得出来。他每回看向偏房，眼神都会短短停一下。那不是担心死人，是担心死人身上留下不该留下的东西。

    真当是亡兄厉鬼害人，他该催着她去坟前打散亡魂才对，哪有急着把她从尸体边上赶开的道理。

    越急，越有鬼。

    沈清萝心里有数，脸上却不露。

    他懒得再同她绕，抬手指向梁氏。

    “大嫂身子弱，受不得惊。沈姑娘若再拿亡魂鬼事吓她，梁家可不会客气。”

    沈清萝把黄纸折好，塞回布包。

    “梁二爷来得正好。”

    她往前一步。

    “祖坟闹煞，小厮横死，梁大爷亡魂被疑为恶鬼。现在当着族老的面，先验尸。”

    梁二叔眼皮一跳。

    “验尸？阿福死在坟前，眼睛睁得那样，不是被厉鬼吓死，还能是什么？”

    沈清萝看着他。

    “谁告诉你是恶鬼？”

    廊下一静。

    这句不重，却像一根针，扎在梁二叔最急着盖住的地方。

    偏房里，小厮阿福的尸身还停在木板上。
content_en:
Uncle Liang stood in the corridor, his face darker than the night.

    Behind him were two clan elders and several servants carrying lanterns. The light of the fire was blown by the wind, making people's faces flicker in and out. Mrs. Liang stood in the room, the concoction spilled all over the floor, and her fingers were still trembling.

    Shen Qingluo held the blood-stained pattern and did not speak in a hurry.

    Uncle Liang laughed first.

    "Miss Shen is very capable."

    It's a boast, but it doesn't feel like a boast. There's fire underneath every word.

    "My Liang family paid you to help quell the ghost problem. It would be better for you to go to the inner house and force my sister-in-law to say these crazy things. Why, the tombkeeper Xuansi is still in charge of other people's houses now?"

    Liang's face turned pale.

    She subconsciously stepped back, like she had done many times before, back into the circle that Uncle Liang had drawn for her.

    Shen Qingluo glanced at her but didn't help her.

    There is no point in supporting him. This person has to learn to stand on his own.

    Xie Wujiu stood by the door and lazily raised his eyelids. The servants in the corridor were about to move forward, but they all stopped when they caught his sight.

    Uncle Liang also noticed him.

    "This young master is quite unfamiliar."

    Shen Qingluo said smoothly: "Temporary assistant."

    Xie Wujiu looked at her.

    Shen Qingluo didn't look at him.

    She is too busy now to coax someone who refuses to admit that he is a buddy.

    Uncle Liang sneered: "The guy hired by Miss Shen doesn't look like an ordinary person."

    "Ordinary clerks are expensive." Shen Qingluo said, "This is temporarily on credit."

    Ah Qing almost laughed out loud at the soul-inducing bell.

    Xie Wujiu's face turned even colder.

    Uncle Liang had no intention of talking nonsense with her.

    He wasn't completely unafraid either.

    Shen Qingluo could tell. Every time he looked at the side room, his eyes would pause briefly. It's not about worrying about the dead, it's about worrying about leaving things on the dead that shouldn't be left behind.

    It was really the ghost of her deceased brother who was harming others. He should have urged her to go to the grave to disperse the ghosts. There was no reason to rush her away from the corpse.

    The more urgent it is, the more evil it is.

    Shen Qingluo knew what she was thinking, but she didn't show it on her face.

    He was too lazy to go around her anymore and raised his hand to point at Mrs. Liang.

    "Sister-in-law is weak and cannot be frightened. If Miss Shen scares her again with ghost stories, the Liang family will not be polite."

    Shen Qingluo folded the yellow paper and stuffed it back into the cloth bag.

    "Second Master Liang came just in time."

    She took a step forward.

    "There was a disturbance in the ancestral grave, the young man died violently, and the soul of Uncle Liang is suspected to be an evil ghost. Now, in front of the clan elders, we will conduct an autopsy first."

    Uncle Liang's eyelids twitched.

    "Autopsy? Ah Fu died in front of the grave with his eyes open like that. If he wasn't frightened to death by a ghost, what else could it be?"

    Shen Qingluo looked at him.

    "Who told you it was an evil spirit?"

    The corridor is quiet.

    This sentence is not serious, but it is like a needle piercing the place where Second Uncle Liang is most anxious to cover up.

    In the side room, the body of Ah Fu, the boy, was still lying on the wooden board.
